termsFrozenNote: Showing the frozen version of {{date}} — this is exactly what the parties sign.

termsEmpty: Terms are not filled in yet.

amendment.title: Amendment No. {{order}}
amendment.changesEmpty: No milestone changes — only the wording of the terms.
amendment.antiWaiverTitle: The discount covers only the specified defect
amendment.underReviewText: Under review. “Sign” locks in the amendment version and adds your signature.
amendment.draftText: Not yet sent for review — it can’t be signed yet.
amendment.closedText: Review is closed — the contract terms don’t change.
amendment.signedText: The contract terms have been updated since the second signature.
amendment.ceremonySubtitle: The version is locked in, both parties signed, the contract is updated
amendment.errVersionStale: The amendment version is out of date — refresh the page and sign again.
amendment.errTargetsAccepted: The milestone is already accepted — its amount can’t be reduced or removed by an amendment.
amendment.draftPendingTitle: An amendment draft is waiting to be sent
amendment.pendingText: The contract terms change only after both parties sign.
amendment.rejectText: Negotiation will close for good: the contract terms stay unchanged. The initiator can propose a new amendment.
amendment.withdrawText: The amendment will be withdrawn and any signatures annulled. This cannot be undone — create a new amendment if needed.
amendment.closedRejectedText: The other party rejected the amendment — the contract terms stay unchanged.
amendment.closedWithdrawnText: The initiator withdrew the amendment — the contract terms stay unchanged.
amendment.errNotInitiator: Only the initiator can withdraw an amendment — you can reject it instead.
amendment.errNotCounterparty: Only the other party can reject an amendment — the initiator withdraws it.
amendment.errInvalidTransition: This action is not available in the current amendment status — refresh the page.
amendment.reasonHint: Briefly — why the terms of a signed agreement are changing.
amendment.previewAmount: The agreement total will change by {{delta}}. The final figure is computed by the server on save.
amendment.customTermsHint: Text that goes into the amendment as is.
amendment.deleteText: The draft is visible only to you and will be deleted without a trace. An amendment already sent for review cannot be deleted this way — it is withdrawn instead.
amendment.errNotDraft: The amendment has already been sent — only a draft can be edited or deleted.
amendment.errContractNotSigned: An amendment can only be added to a signed agreement.
amendment.errTargetsReceivedMaterial: A material that has already been received cannot be removed.
amendment.errCurrencyMismatch: The changes mix currencies — keep a single one.
amendment.tabIntroTitle: An amendment changes a signed agreement
amendment.tabIntroText: A signed agreement is immutable. Any change to its terms is a separate amendment that both parties sign anew.

retention.title: We confirm the authenticity of your documents indefinitely
retention.summary: The files themselves: {{hot}} of quick access, then the archive — {{archive}} in total after the contract ends. {{notice}} before deletion we will remind you to download them; an open dispute extends the period.
retention.detailsHashes: Hashes and timestamps of every document in the deal stay with us indefinitely: at any time you can confirm that your file is the very one recorded in the deal.
retention.detailsHot: For {{hot}} after the contract ends, files open right in the deal card.
retention.detailsArchive: Then they move to the archive; the total retention period is {{archive}} after the contract ends. {{notice}} before deletion both parties get a reminder to download the archive.
retention.detailsDispute: If a dispute is open, deletion is postponed for the duration of the dispute, but by no more than {{cap}} after it is resolved.
retention.detailsYours: After that the files are yours: your saved copy together with our permanent hashes proves their authenticity.
